packageRules.description: One PR for all minor, patch and digest updates; every major update gets its own PR, opened only after it is approved in the Dependency Dashboard (security-fix PRs from OSV data excepted).

npm, PyPI, Go and Maven/Gradle releases wait one day against supply-chain attacks. Security-fix PRs from OSV data (direct dependencies only; transitive osv-scanner findings need a manual lockfile update or an overrides entry) are not delayed: they are forced through the vulnerabilityAlerts block, whose default sets minimumReleaseAge to null. Docker images, GitHub Actions and digests are not delayed.

Do not propose Python 3.15 or newer (python Docker image, server/.python-version) until psycopg-binary ships wheels for it: 3.3.4 has none, so uv sync --frozen fails on 3.15. Remove this rule once psycopg-binary publishes 3.15 wheels.
